name: project-compass
description: Side pane, refreshed after each turn: project objective, top next steps, open risks and estimated completion

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.description: When the compass reassesses the project; each assessment is one model call. turn: after every turn. interval: every few turns (see Refresh interval). edits: after a turn that edited files. manual: only when you run /compass refresh.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh interval
refreshInterval.description: How many turns between assessments when Refresh is interval.

account.title: Account line
account.description: What shows under the project name. full: your email and plan. plan: the plan alone. off: nothing, and the CLI is never asked who is signed in.
